crm.truncated: Only the first 5,000 rows are imported.

crm.name: Name
crm.eraseBody: This permanently deletes the person, their activities, comments, files and consent records. It cannot be undone. Deals stay, without this contact.
crm.atRiskBanner: One of this client's projects is in the red zone. Check it before the relationship suffers.
crm.archiveBlocked: Close or move its open deals first.
crm.archiveConfirm: Archive this company? Its contacts and deals stay.
crm.clientMapHint: Dashed lines link a deal to the project it started. Red means trouble.
crm.stageHasDeals: Stage “{name}” has deals. Choose where they go, then save again.
crm.pipelinesHint: Stages, order and win probability. Every pipeline ends with one Won and one Lost stage.
crm.deletePipelineConfirm: Delete this pipeline? It must have no deals.
crm.lostReasonsHint: A deal can only be marked lost with one of these.
crm.projectTemplatesHint: Used when a won deal becomes a project. Save an existing project as a template to reuse its structure and timing.
crm.consentTextHint: Shows a checkbox; ticking it records consent (GDPR).
crm.allowedOriginsHint: One per line. Empty = any site. Browsers on other sites cannot submit.
crm.noForms: No forms yet. Create one and paste the code on your site.
crm.deleteFormConfirm: Delete this form? Embedded copies will stop working.
crm.webhookHint: POST JSON or a form to this URL with an Authorization: Bearer token. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.
crm.tokenOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown only once.
crm.tokenExists: A token exists. Rotating it stops the old one working.
crm.rotateConfirm: Rotate the token? Integrations using the old one will stop working.
crm.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 5 MB. For Excel the first sheet is read and the first filled row is the header.
crm.noteColumnsHint: Tick the columns to keep in the contact's note, as “Column: value”.
crm.importTimeout: The server took too long and stopped. Nothing was imported. Try again; if it keeps happening, split the file into smaller parts.
crm.planZoneHint: Times are in {zone}, your time zone.
crm.planCalendarHint: It goes into your calendar and My day, and stays on this contact until you mark it done.
crm.peopleTruncated: Only the first 1,500 people are drawn. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
crm.peopleEmpty: Write down everyone you know, {goal} names or more, without filtering: sorting comes later. Paste them here, one on a line, or import a sheet.
crm.namesHint: One person on a line. After a semicolon: @telegram, a phone, or a note. “Name — note” also works.
crm.namesPlaceholder:
Anna Kowalska; @annak; +48 600 111 222
Egor Potapov — met at the conference
Katya and Alex (Cyprus)
crm.namesNone: Nobody yet: the people you type appear here as a count.
crm.namesCount: {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} will be added.
crm.namesTruncated: Only the first 300 lines are taken; add the rest in another go.
crm.addedCount: Added {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} to the funnel.
crm.skippedCount: {n, plural, one {# name was} other {# names were}} already there and skipped:
crm.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this group? Its {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} and its subgroups move up one level; nobody is deleted.
crm.groupExists: A group with this name is already there.
crm.groupTooDeep: Groups go three levels deep at most.
crm.groupCycle: A group cannot go inside itself or its own subgroup.
crm.groupLimit: That is the most groups a workspace can hold.
crm.groupsEmpty: Make groups to split a long list into lots: cold market, warm market, a city, an event.
crm.pickedCount: {n, plural, one {# person selected} other {# people selected}}
crm.noPartnersYet: No partners yet: set a person's stage to Partner and they will appear here.
crm.linkedAccountHint: If this partner works in MeetOwl, people handed to them become theirs and show in their lists.
crm.teamEmpty: Move a person to the Partner stage, and name their sponsor in the card: the team tree builds itself.
crm.netShown: {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} on the map
crm.netTruncated: Only {n} of {total} people are drawn. Use groups or hide the lost to see the rest.

crm.netYou: You · {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

crm.stepDoneNext: Done; the next step in {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
crm.teamWeekHint: What happened with the people each partner works with: moves into a stage during the week.
crm.scriptsHint: A ready text for each moment: the first message, the invitation, the follow-up. Write '{name}' for the person's first name, '{full_name}' for the whole name and '{my_name}' for yours; the text is copied with them filled in.
crm.scriptsEmpty: No scripts yet. Add the text you send most often.
crm.scriptsNoneForStage: No script for this stage yet.
crm.scriptLimit: That is the most scripts a workspace can hold.
crm.autoPlanHint: When a person moves into a stage, their next step fills in by itself: what to do and in how many days. Leave the text empty for a stage that needs no next step.

developers.title: API and webhooks
developers.paywallTitle: The API is part of the Pro plan
developers.paywallText: Personal access tokens and signed webhooks.
developers.tokensHint: A token acts as you inside this workspace, with the rights you have. Send it as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN.
developers.name: Name
developers.tokenOnce: Copy your token now. It is shown only once.
developers.webhooksHint: MeetOwl sends signed JSON to your https URL (header MeetOwl-Signature: t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body"). Failed deliveries are retried for about 15 hours.
developers.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now. It is shown only once.
developers.claudeHint: Let Claude read and change this workspace for you: ask it for your day, to add a task or a meeting, to find a client or move a deal.

developers.claudeStep2: Name it MeetOwl and paste this address:
developers.claudeStep3: Press Connect, sign in to MeetOwl if asked, choose this workspace and allow access.
developers.claudeCode: Using Claude Code or another program?
developers.claudeCodeHint: Claude Code opens the same sign-in window. A program that cannot sign in can use a personal token from below as a Bearer header.

oauth.intro: {app} asks to work in MeetOwl as you ({email}). It will see and change only what you can.
